The basic objective of this wing is to strengthen the nation, eradicate social evils, promote unity by eliminating caste differences, and dedicate itself to serving society, religion and nation during disasters and calamities.

This wing organizes youth and encourages their participation in education, employment, politics, religion and national policy. It aims to establish youth as role models and will deploy "Yuvasena" wherever youth interests require representation, including schools and colleges.

This wing works to protect the purity and sanctity of temples, monasteries, saints, religious leaders, Batuks, Vedas, Puranas and Upanishads, and make them accessible to people. It also protects the cow and other religious symbols. It will be led by saints, scholars and religious gurus, with the objective of teaching and training in weapons based on scriptures.

This wing will have 09 Vice-Presidents representing farmers, labourers, employees, shopkeepers and traders, taxi-rickshaw operators, street-cart traders, fruit and vegetable producers, medicine producers, and artists, producers and directors. Its aim is to ensure that all sections of the nation receive their rights.

This wing aims to connect people of Indian origin who are deprived of basic facilities with India's original Sanatani spirit. It seeks to organize and empower them by addressing their social, economic, political and religious concerns and creating awareness of their rights.

Journalists, lawyers and social service organizations will participate in this wing. Its main task is to communicate the objectives of Sarvjan Sanatan Party to the public, organize small meetings, establish direct communication with people and work towards the welfare of society and the country.

This wing aims to organize retired army and police officers, doctors, professors, thinkers, historians, litterateurs, poets, political analysts, journalists, lawyers, IAS officers, Vedic scholars, saints, scientists and researchers from various disciplines to develop initiatives in the national interest.

This wing aims to empower women, girls, youth, the transgender community and people who are weak, backward, deprived or exploited. It seeks to eradicate social evils and strengthen society through cottage, rural and small-scale industries to make the country self-reliant.

This wing works against adulteration, collusion, inaccuracies, violation of consumer rights, unfulfilled promises and misleading advertising. It aims to protect consumers by establishing direct communication with consumer courts and creating awareness about the quality of goods and services.
